title: Adaptive Financial Transformer with Regime-Gated Attention for Cross-Sectional H198 Ranking
source: arXiv:2606.29347 (Sarkar, Jun 2026) — "Adaptive Financial Transformer with Regime-Gated Attention for Stock Return Prediction"
summary: AFT groups 95 engineered financial features into 11 semantic categories (momentum, reversal, vol, quality, etc.), encodes a latent market regime via a Market Regime Encoder, and biases self-attention through an Adaptive Gate Network so each regime activates different feature relationships. Paper identifies and corrects sequence-alignment look-ahead bugs in prior transformer finance work. H456 ports AFT's regime-gated attention to the H198 30-stock NASDAQ universe: lightweight PyTorch model trained IS 2013-2020, ranked cross-sectionally OOS 2021-2026. Variants range from full AFT architecture to ablations that isolate which component (regime encoder, adaptive gate, or both) drives the lift over plain momentum.
variants: Var A: Full AFT — Market Regime Encoder + Adaptive Gate + 11-category feature groups, top-6 long
Var B: AFT no regime encoder — plain transformer on 95 features, top-6 (ablation)
Var C: AFT no adaptive gate — regime-encoded features but uniform attention, top-6
Var D: Lightweight regime proxy — VIX + SPY 200MA state as regime input, plain momentum reranked, top-6
Var E: H198 baseline 6-1m momentum top-6 (sanity check)
gate: OOS Sharpe >= 1.174 (H198 baseline) AND MaxDD improvement vs baseline
